text.p: Diversified manufacturing group Futuris Corp Ltd said on Monday it would extend its takeover offer for pastoral group Elders Australia Ltd to October 28 from the current close date of September 30.
Futuris said it now had 82.75 percent of Elders.

Futuris and Elders originally proposed a merger, but the move was stymied by overseas investors General Oriental Investments Ltd and Marathon Asset Management, which hold a combined stake of around 15 percent in Elders and were critical of merging the pastoral and industrial businesses.
Futuris is offering 10 of its shares for every nine Elders shares plus 23 cents per Elders share.
Elders and Futuris shares both closed steady at A$1.85 and A$1.49 respectively.
The bid values each Elders share at A$1.88 based on Monday's closing prices and value the company at A$281.56 million.
